exposure: time of day of unscheduled cesarean section (day vs. night)
cohort: Two hundred and forty postnatal mothers who underwent unscheduled cesarean section at Kenyatta National Hospital, Nairobi, Kenya between February 26th and April 2nd, 2015.
finding: There was no significant difference in pregnancy outcomes between unscheduled cesarean sections performed during the day compared to those performed at night.
